authority: Brain maker-checker ruling 2026-09-20 on sprint item 1
contract: A height here is NOT a product fact. It is applied only as dimensions_mm.height with dimensions_source 'category_default:<category>' and dimensions_axes 'WD+H_DEFAULT'. Platform must render such items with the INDICATIVE chip (#c18a2d) and must never quote the height as a specification. Width and depth on these rows remain source-stated.

FFE.BEDROOM.BED_FRAME.why: Swedish continental bed: base plus mattress top surface sits 55-65 cm; 60 cm is the mid-market norm.

FFE.BEDROOM.MATTRESS.why: Standard pocket-spring mattress depth for the SE market.

FFE.BEDROOM.HEADBOARD.why: Gavel height measured from floor on a 60 cm bed; ~120 cm is the common size.

FFE.TEXTILES.RUG.why: Woven pile thickness; a rug is a floor layer, not a volume.

FFE.TEXTILES.BEDDING.why: Duvet/linen laid on a bed; a surface layer, not a volume.

ELECTRICAL.LUMINAIRES.PENDANT.why: Shade body height only; cable drop is install-dependent and NOT included.

ELECTRICAL.LUMINAIRES.CEILING.why: Flush-mount plafond projects ~12 cm below the ceiling.

ELECTRICAL.LUMINAIRES.TABLE.why: Table lamp total height, base to shade top.

FFE.TABLE.DINING.why: EN 527 / market-standard dining table top height.

FFE.TABLE.COFFEE.why: Coffee table top height relative to a 40-45 cm seat.

FFE.TABLE.SIDE.why: Side table sits between seat and armrest height.

FFE.OUTDOOR.CHAIR.why: Outdoor dining chair overall height (seat ~45 cm plus back).

FFE.OUTDOOR.SET.why: Dining set envelope is driven by its table height.

FFE.SEATING.SOFA.why: Sofa overall height to back top.

FFE.SEATING.ARMCHAIR.why: Armchair overall height to back top.

FFE.SEATING.DINING_CHAIR.why: Dining chair overall height to back top.

refused.CATALOG_ONLY: Unclassified: no category, so no category default can apply.
refused.FFE.OUTDOOR: Generic bucket mixing furniture, structures and accessories; one height would be wrong for most of it.
refused.FFE.BATHROOM: Generic bucket mixing fixtures, cabinets and accessories.
refused.OTHER.PROTECTOR: Covers/protectors are a surface layer over another product; no standalone height.
refused.FFE.OUTDOOR.SHADE: Mixes WALL-MOUNTED awnings (markis) with FREE-STANDING gazebos/pergolas; a single default is wrong for roughly half the rows.
refused.FFE.DECOR.ART: The two parsed numbers are W x H (a wall-hung plane), not a footprint; adding a third axis would misread the source.
refused.FFE.DECOR.MIRROR: Same W x H wall-plane problem as ART.
refused.FFE.SURFACE.WALLPAPER: Sold by roll length x width; not a placed object.
refused.FFE.TEXTILES.TOWEL: Folded textile, not a placed object.
refused.ELECTRICAL.BULBS: Light sources are fitted inside a luminaire; never placed independently.
refused.ELECTRICAL.LUMINAIRES.ACCESSORY: Shades, cords, dimmers and transformers have no common envelope.
refused.ELECTRICAL.LUMINAIRES.DECORATIVE: Light strings/stars vary from centimetres to metres; no defensible single value.
